plan.role: New development geometry; reference-only localization, not independent H1 acceptance.
plan.input: Complete reference in top 432x216 region; blank lower half. No current state, candidate boxes, labels or target markers.
plan.output: Four integer centerline bounds x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max; fixed syntax, all coordinates in canvas range are eligible.
plan.scoring: Mean absolute coordinate error; all four coordinates within 12 pixels; invalid box rate; per geometry group.
plan.policy: One prompt, one final adapter, no prompt search or training; no original visual test cases.

decoding: Greedy token trie over all in-range integer coordinates; fixed JSON punctuation. No candidate boxes or label access.
